prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Agricultural Chemicals (pesticides), Company Size: 130 employees, Pain Points: Label compliance issues in 2 markets, environmental monitoring not performed at boundary, transport documentation gaps, worker exposure monitoring lapsed

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore": "Low", "gaps": "Label compliance issues across two markets, lack of environmental monitoring at facility boundaries, incomplete transport documentation, and lapsed worker exposure monitoring indicate significant gaps in quality, environmental, and safety management systems.", "recommendations": "Implement ISO 14001 for environmental management to address boundary monitoring and transport documentation gaps; adopt ISO 45001 to re-establish worker exposure monitoring protocols; conduct comprehensive label compliance audits against ISO/IEC 17025 and local regulations; develop a documented transport management procedure aligned with ISO 39001; establish routine environmental monitoring at all facility boundaries with documented reporting.", "standards": "ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), ISO/IEC 17025 (Testing Laboratories), ISO 39001 (Road Traffic Safety Management)"}
